app.name: InvoiceFlow
app.tagline: Invoices into spreadsheets, clean and under control

meta.homeDescription: Upload PDF, XML and image invoices; extract, review and export CSV/XLSX for business accounting.
meta.workspaceDescription: Batch upload PDF, XML, JPG and PNG invoices for data extraction.
meta.editorDescription: Review, correct and arrange invoice data before export.

landing.headline: From a stack of invoices to a clean spreadsheet, in one session
landing.subhead: Upload XML e-invoices, PDFs or photos. Review the cells that need attention, fix in batches and export CSV/XLSX.
landing.step1Body: Drag and drop many invoices at once.
landing.step2Body: Read XML, PDF text and recognise characters right in the browser.
landing.step3Body: Prioritise cells that need checking and see exactly where they sit on the original.
landing.step4Body: Download CSV or XLSX using your column template.
landing.privacyBody: In default mode, invoice content is processed in browser memory. We only store account preferences and export templates when you sign in and choose to save. We will publish network audit results before making any privacy guarantees.
landing.faq1A: No. You can upload, review and export without signing in. Google sign-in is only used to save export templates.
landing.faq2Q: Are my invoices uploaded to a server?
landing.faq2A: In default mode, files are processed locally in the browser. Export templates only contain column settings, never invoice content.
landing.faq3Q: How many invoices can I upload at once?
landing.faq3A: During beta, up to {{count}} files per batch.
landing.faq4A: The first version exports one row per invoice. Line items are not supported yet.

autofill.title: Auto-fill from example
autofill.description: Learn how you took the “{{field}}” value from invoice {{doc}}, then find each other invoice's own value. The same value is never copied across rows.
autofill.placeSameLine: Same line, right of the label
autofill.unlocated: Could not tell where the example value sits on the invoice (typed by hand, or not in the text). Only the standard label suggestions are available and every row needs review.
autofill.registryDiffers: On the example invoice the standard-label suggestion differs from the value you picked, so standard suggestions on other invoices are for reference only and are not pre-selected.
autofill.unsupportedField: This field is not read from invoice text, so it cannot be learned from an example.
autofill.scopeSupplierHint: Invoices with the same tax code or seller name.
autofill.scopeLayoutHint: Same printed labels in nearly the same places ({{pct}}%+), not just the same file type.
autofill.scopeBatchHint: Every other invoice; confidence is based on the learned label.
autofill.groupReadyHint: Match the learned label and position. Selected by default.
autofill.groupReviewHint: Weak evidence or several similar values. Not selected by default.
autofill.groupProtectedHint: Kept as is. Overwritten only if you enable the option below.
autofill.none: No similar values found in other invoices.
autofill.doneOverride: Cells filled: {{count}}, including {{protected}} protected cells overwritten.
autofill.protectedNote: Verified, hand-typed or document-assigned cells are never overwritten unless you allow it.
autofill.needExample: Select a cell that already has a value to use as the example.
autofill.unchanged: Invoices already holding this value: {{count}}. Nothing to change.

batch.title: Batch correction
batch.description: Find other cells with the same “{{signature}}” problem and propose each invoice's own value.
batch.modeCorrected: Based on the cell you just fixed: the app learns where the correct value sits and looks for the matching value in other invoices.
batch.modeFlagged: This cell still has the problem, so there is no correct example to learn from. Only the app's standard label suggestions are used.
batch.signatureSupplier: Only invoices from the same supplier
batch.groupReviewHint: Weak evidence or several similar values. Not selected by default.
batch.groupProtectedHint: Kept as is. Overwritten only if you enable the option below.
batch.none: No other cell has the same problem.
batch.doneOverride: Cells fixed: {{count}}, including {{protected}} protected cells overwritten.
batch.protectedNote: Verified, hand-typed or document-assigned cells are never overwritten unless you allow it.
